results.name: Devil's Slide Bunker - Pacifica, CA
results.description:
And oldie but a goodie. Going through some archives and re-processing unpublished work.

**Description**
Devil's Slide was the location of a military triangulation station and observation site used during World War II as part of the harbor defense of San Francisco. Prior to the advent of radar, military personnel used binoculars and compasses to search for ships at sea and relay their coordinates to a central post. By combining information from multiple observation posts, a ship's precise location could be determined by triangulation. There were six military structures at the Devil's Slide: three concrete and steel observation pill-boxes, two concrete and earth bunkers, and a reinforced steel observation tower. The pill-boxes were used as hardened observation posts, and one of the bunkers was used as a communications and command post. - https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Devil%27s_Slide_(California)

**Technical Notes:**
For use with Unlit shader in Unity - [import instructions](http://azadux.com/import)

results.name: Southwark Borough Control Bunker
results.description:
Photogrammetry capture of Southwark Borough Control bunker under the community plot at the corner of Vestry Road and Peckham Road, London.

These borough control centres were built during the cold war as a place to continue local government during an attack. Few survive in London today so this is a rare 3D record of one such bunker although it is in very poor condition, with flooding throughout.

All information used in the annotating of this model came from this report by Nick Catford (2001):
https://www.subbrit.org.uk/sites/southwark-borough-control/

Huge thank you to local residents Joanna and Joe for inviting me to scan this bunker.

The bunker entrance is locked closed and it is not accessible to the public in its current state.

3240 photos taken in May 2021 with a Sony a6000 and processed in Reality Capture.
Bunker was pitch black so 7 LED camping lights and one LED diffuse panel were used for lighting.

results.name: Dormitory - Assets
results.description:
This is another collection of assets for a personal project of mine that's no longer in production. Assets were inspired by living quarters in various remote research facilities, where workers were stationed for prolonged period of time. Somewhat mismatched, old fashioned, quite worn down, but still practical and usable. 

Everything was done for real-time rendering with a third person perspective, but you can probably use a first person camera, as long as you don’t get too close.

results.name: Underground Bunker
results.description:
This is a PBRish personal project created excusevly for SketchFab. Main goal was to use real-time rendering and not baked lights and shadows to create most interactive scene. And I actually succeed in that. :-)
So, today I wanna invite you to the top secret bunker of Worldwide Secret Television. It was built during the Cold War by enthusiasts, mostly from TV and mass-media industry.
Of course, it wasn't even designed to withstand atomic blast, but surely do it's primary function of a secret hideaway, from where you tell all the truth of the world and communicate to others.
As you can see, today it's pretty old and dated, even natural tree, in which was injected an antenna, works no more as a disguise, but rather this inserted tech helping it not to fall apart. 
As I mentioned previously, this project was done with and for SketchFab viewer, so I have actual WIP scenes, here is one of them: 
 https://skfb.ly/Y6xA 
I wish I can tell you more about this project, but it seems I've reached character limit here.:-)

results.name: Star Wars - Mustafar Control Room
results.description:
"The Separatist Council War Room was a secure command center located in the Klegger Corp Mining Facility on Mustafar during the Clone Wars. It was to here that the leaders of the Confederacy of Independent Systems retreated at the end of the conflict.

The war room was part of a secret command facility built onto the side of the Mustafar mining complex to act as a secure bunker for the Separatist Council. A landing pad was located outside the chamber, with a control room annex used to monitor approaching vessels. An observation balcony running the length of the war room's exterior provided a hellish view of the Mustafar mining operations far below."
Source Info  https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki

FOR EDUCATIONAL USE ONLY

results.name: Buildings of Saceruela Military Airfield
results.description: The military airfield of Saceruela (Ciudad Real) was built during the Spanish Civil War (1936-1939) by the Republican Army to provide aerial coverage to the Extremadura Front. It is one of the most important airfields in the province of Ciudad Real. In the 3D model you can see two of the buildings that were built to house the personnel of the airfield and to repair the aircraft. There is also an enormous bunker under the subsoil, intended to serve as a refuge in the event of an attack by enemy aviation. This bunker was designed to withstand the impact of bombs of up to 100 kilograms and, as can be seen in the 3D model, had its two entrances next to the two buildings on the surface, in order to facilitate a quick escape from its occupants.
